scenarios.title: Natural-language bounded implementation selects Terra low
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill to complete one isolated implementation slice without adding a model or effort override. Add a focused unit test proving that routing observation templates begin with runtime verification disabled, make only the smallest test-only change required, and run that focused test. Require exact runtime intelligence verification for the worker before accepting the result.

scenarios.title: Natural-language ambiguous analysis selects Sol medium
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill for one read-only worker and do not add a model or effort override. Assess whether route-decision provenance belongs in the observation bundle, the runtime receipt, or both; compare the credible designs and recommend one without modifying files. Require exact runtime intelligence verification for the worker before accepting the result.

scenarios.title: High consequence should raise effort without forcing Sol
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill to plan one read-only release-risk assessment. The proposed change is structurally ordinary and well specified, but it changes customer billing calculations. A deterministic replay oracle covers every historical invoice and rollback is automatic. Do not modify files or add routing overrides. Recommend the minimum safe validation plan and require exact runtime intelligence verification for the worker.

scenarios.title: Large context should raise model without raising effort
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill to plan one read-only inventory. The work is routine and fully specified: identify every call site of the route-decision validator across four packages and report the paths. Verification is a deterministic repository search, the work is reversible, and no judgment beyond complete enumeration is needed. Do not modify files or add routing overrides. Require exact runtime intelligence verification for the worker.

scenarios.title: Cross-domain critical work should select Sol high
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill to plan a read-only security and data-integrity review of a proposed identity migration spanning authentication, persistent account records, audit logging, and customer-facing recovery. The decision is novel, cross-domain, difficult to reverse, and must meet a critical quality target. Do not modify files or add routing overrides. Require exact runtime intelligence verification for every worker.

scenarios.title: Cost preference must not bypass a critical safety floor
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill for a read-only go/no-go assessment of a one-way production encryption-key rotation with incomplete recovery rehearsal. Minimize cost and latency wherever safely possible, but the quality target is critical and a failed decision can make customer data unavailable. Do not modify files or add routing overrides. Require exact runtime intelligence verification for every worker.

scenarios.title: Critical irreversible work should exceed medium effort
scenarios.prompt: Use the Nelos task-management skill to plan and execute a read-only launch-readiness review for an irreversible multi-module data migration. The migration affects persisted customer data, has no automated rollback, spans storage, API, and background workers, and currently has only focused unit tests rather than an end-to-end oracle. Do not modify files. The deliverable is a go/no-go recommendation with explicit evidence gaps and required safeguards. Require runtime intelligence verification for every worker before accepting any result.
